title: fix: error on delivery of multiple release artifacts of same project
summary: The CreateRelease workflow now prevents redundant artifact deliveries by only running NuGet and Storage delivery steps when the matrix processes the Apps artifact type, eliminating duplicate delivery attempts.
key_points: Modified if conditions in CreateRelease.yaml templates to check matrix.atype == 'Apps'
Prevents Deliver to NuGet step from running multiple times per project
Prevents Deliver to Storage step from running multiple times per project
Fixes issue where matrix iterations over different artifact types triggered redundant deliveries
